# The Lulla production loop (per song)

```
 Suno track (CHROME)  →  scenes ready  →  publish_song.py  →  scheduled on YouTube
```

## 1. Song — ALWAYS generated by driving Suno in Chrome
Suno has no clean API we use, so song generation is **always Chrome-driven** (Claude drives the logged-in Suno tab). Per song:
1. Open Suno (Advanced mode) in Chrome.
2. Paste the song's **lyrics** (with `[Verse]/[Chorus]/…` tags) + the **style** line from `songs/0N-*.md`.
3. Generate on **Pro** (commercial rights), pick the calmest take.
4. Download it into the project as `songs/song0N.mp3`.
   - Fast path Claude uses: read the clip's song id from the page, then
     `curl -L https://cdn1.suno.ai/<songId>.mp3 -o songs/song0N.mp3`.

> This is the one step that isn't a pure script — Claude does it in Chrome on request.

## 2. Scenes
- Reuse the existing library in `assets/scenes/` (see each song doc's "Scenes" section).
- Generate any new shots with `scripts/leo_generate.sh` (Lucid Origin, 1344×768).
- Write the shot list `songs/0N_shots.json` (list of `{img, dur, motion}`).

## 3. Produce + publish — ONE command
```bash
python3 scripts/publish_song.py \
  --audio songs/song0N.mp3 --shots songs/0N_shots.json \
  --title "…" --desc-file songs/desc_0N.txt \
  --tags "…" --thumbnail assets/thumbnail/thumb0N_final.jpg \
  --publish-at "2026-08-07T16:00:00+05:30"
```
This renders (Ken Burns + glow-breathe + crossfades, cut to the song) and uploads + schedules it, sets Made-for-Kids, attaches the thumbnail, and (optionally) adds it to a playlist — all via the YouTube Data API. No Chrome needed for publishing.

## Scripts
| Script | Role |
|---|---|
| `leo_generate.sh` / `leo_ref_gen.py` | generate scene images (Leonardo) |
| `make_thumbnail.py` / `make_channel_art.py` | thumbnails + channel art |
| `assemble_video.py` | still scenes → motion video (Ken Burns, crossfade, glow-breathe, audio) |
| `youtube_upload.py` | upload + schedule + thumbnail + playlist (Data API) |
| **`publish_song.py`** | **the one-liner: render → publish** |

## Recurring notes
- Custom thumbnail via API needs the channel **phone-verified** (one-time).
- Category: `--category 10` Music (default) / `27` Education.
- Launch cadence & queue: `docs/CHANNEL-SETUP.md`.
